name: Rathalos / Ceanataur mix
summary: Razor Sharp and enough raw to carry low rank until High rank opens.
notes: Starter: full Kut-Ku + 5 Attack Jewels gives Attack Up (Medium) + Health +20 for almost no farming.
Target: Rathalos / Ceanataur pieces plus five Razor Jewels. Razor Sharp keeps you in the high sharpness bracket; the lost attack tier is worth it on most blademaster weapons.
Razor Jewel is the limiting craft. If you cannot make five yet, full Rathalos (Attack Up Large) is the bridge.
weaponNote: SnS, DB, LS, lance, and gunlance. Great Sword / Hammer can stay in full Rathalos until High rank.

name: Rathalos Soul + HGE
summary: High Grade Earplug with Attack Up (Medium): roar-safe without going full support.
notes: Starter: full Kut-Ku + 5 Strength Jewels gives Health +50 and Attack Up (Small) for early comfort.
Target: Rathalos Soul plus four Earplug Jewels. Two Protection Jewels keep the set's negative Protection skill from activating.
One spare slot. Add a weapon slot or an Evade / Health jewel if you have one.
weaponNote: Hammer, Great Sword, Long Sword, and Hunting Horn. HGE lets you finish big attacks through roars.

name: Ceanataur / Rathalos S mix
summary: Sharpness +1 and Attack Up (Large): the high-rank blademaster damage core.
notes: Starter: full Kut-Ku S + 5 Defense Jewels + 2 Fierce Jewels gives Attack Up (Large) and Fire Resist +5. Gem out Kut-Ku S's Defence penalty.
Target: three Ceanataur S pieces and two Rathalos S pieces. Two Fierce and four Artisan Jewels finish both skills.
Hunt Ceanataur for the S pieces first; the Artisan Jewels are the main material gate.
weaponNote: Every blademaster class. Sharpness +1 is the single biggest high-rank upgrade for most weapons.

name: Rathalos Soul U + HGE
summary: High Grade Earplug plus Crit Eye: the standard roar-safe high-rank shell.
notes: Five Strength Jewels cancel the Rathalos Soul U set's Health -10 malus.
Four spare slots: add Guard / Evade for your weapon, or Attack if you already have HGE elsewhere.
Cheaper: full Tigrex S + 1 Protection Jewel gives Earplug and Quick Eating, but not HGE.
weaponNote: Hammer, Great Sword, Long Sword, Hunting Horn. Lance / Gunlance can spend the spare slots on Guard.

name: Diablos Z crit
summary: Crit Eye +3 and Razor Sharp behind an Earplug safety net.
notes: Three Protection Jewels drop the Diablos Z set's Demonic Protection below activation; Hermit + five Expert Jewels reach Crit Eye +3.
Starter: full Rathalos X + 6 QuickCharge + 5 Grinder gives Attack Up (Large), Crit Draw, and Sharpening Skill Inc. Use it if you need Crit Draw for Great Sword.
Swap to a Sharpness +1 mix if your weapon needs the extra sharpness tier more than Razor Sharp.
weaponNote: Raw SnS, DB, LS, and Lance. Great Sword should use the Rathalos X starter for Crit Draw.

name: Narga X evade
summary: Evade +2 and Evade Distance: the G-rank dodge shell.
notes: Four Fierce Jewels offset Narga X's Attack -11; the set ends at Attack +1, so no Attack Down.
Three spare slots. Add Health, Guard, or weapon-specific jewels.
Blocking weapons should use Guard +2 instead; this set is for hop / dodge play.
weaponNote: Lance / Gunlance hop, SnS, DB, LS. Narga X is also a fine base for mixed Evade sets.

name: Kut-Ku gunner
summary: Early gunner attack shell with a health buffer.
notes: Starter: full Kut-Ku gunner + 5 Attack Jewels reaches Attack Up (Medium) and Health +20.
No shot-type skill yet; use this until you can build Battle (Normal S Up / Load) or Ceanataur (Pierce S Up) pieces.
Gunner defence is low, so Health +20 matters more than it looks.
weaponNote: LBG, HBG, and bow. Attack Up helps every shot type; add the matching shot-up skill next.

name: Rathalos Soul gunner + HGE
summary: High Grade Earplug for safe reloads and charge windows.
notes: Rathalos Soul gunner + four Earplug Jewels + two Protection Jewels gives Attack Up (Medium) + HGE.
One spare slot; use it for Health or a weapon gem.
Cheaper: full Kut-Ku gunner + 5 Strength Jewels gives Health +50 and Attack Up (Small).
weaponNote: Bow and bowgun. HGE is especially good on HBG and bow, where roars interrupt long animations.

name: Silver Sol Pierce
summary: Silver Sol's Pierce Up + Attack Up (Large) shell.
notes: Full Silver Sol gunner naturally has Pierce Up and Attack Up (Small). Three Fierce + one Attack Jewel push it to Attack Up (Large).
Three Defense Jewels cancel the set's Defence -9 malus.
Use Pierce S on long monsters. For Normal S, mix Conga or Ioprey high-rank pieces for Normal S Up.
weaponNote: Pierce LBG / HBG and Pierce bow. The set is slot-hungry but needs no rare charm.

name: Obituary evade
summary: Evade +2, Status Attack Up, and Health +20 from Obituary gunner.
notes: Two Warm Breeze Jewels keep the set's Cold Res -11 below activation; five Strength Jewels add Health +20.
Status Atk Up makes para / sleep LBG noticeably better; Evade +2 covers reloads.
One spare slot for a weapon gem.
weaponNote: Status LBG, or any gunner who wants Evade +2 while learning a monster.

name: Rathalos X Normal
summary: Normal / Rapid Up + Attack Up (Large) + Health +20.
notes: Six QuickCharge Jewels cancel the Rathalos X gunner set's Fast Charge -11; five Strength Jewels add Health +20.
Normal S Up also boosts Rapid Bow, so this shell works for rapid bows.
Starter-friendly: all gems are 1-slot and the armor is core G-rank Rathalos.
weaponNote: Rapid-fire Normal LBG, Normal HBG, and rapid bow.

name: Narga X gunner evade
summary: Evade +2 and Evade Distance on the Narga X gunner shell.
notes: Four Fierce Jewels offset Attack -11; the set ends at Attack +1, so no Attack Down.
Three spare slots for Health, reload, or recoil gems.
Same comfort core as the blademaster set, with gunner defence.
weaponNote: Evade gunner set for LBG / HBG / bow. Add recoil / reload gems for your bowgun.

name: Kirin S element
summary: Element Atk Up and All Resist: the high-rank elemental base.
notes: Full Kirin S gives Element Atk Up. Five StayingPwr Jewels keep the set's Everlastng penalty below activation.
One spare slot: add Load / Recoil for bowguns, or Attack for melee.
No Sharpness +1 here. Pair it with a weapon that already has good sharpness, or mix Ceanataur S.
weaponNote: Elemental LBG and elemental bow. Swap jewels for shot-type skills on bowguns.

name: Kushala / Conga bow
summary: Focus and Normal / Rapid Up: the high-rank bow core.
notes: Five QuickCharge and four StrongShot Jewels finish both skills.
No spare slots; use a weapon with a slot if you need Load.
For Pierce bows, replace StrongShot with Pierce jewels and a Pierce helm.
weaponNote: Rapid / Normal bow. Focus cuts charge time, which is both damage and comfort.

name: Steel / Gravios guard
summary: Guard +1 and Defence +30: the high-rank blocking base.
notes: Two Turtle and one Defense Jewel reach Defence +30 and Guard +1.
One spare slot; add Guard Up or Health if you have it.
For Guard +2, solve for Guard 20 with the same pieces.
weaponNote: Lance and Gunlance. Guard +1 is enough for most high-rank blocking.

name: Rathalos X Crit Draw
summary: Crit Draw + Attack Up (Large) + faster sharpening: the G-rank GS starter.
notes: Six QuickCharge Jewels cancel the set's Fast Charge -11; five Grinder Jewels add Sharpening Skill Inc.
No spare slots; use a weapon with a slot if you need Focus.
This is the starter. The Diablos Z crit set is the next step if you do not need Crit Draw.
weaponNote: Great Sword. Draw attacks crit; Focus is the next upgrade.

name: Silver Sol Z Pierce
summary: Pierce Up + Attack Up (Large): the G-rank HBG raw shell.
notes: Silver Sol Z body pieces plus high-rank Silver Sol Leggings. Two Fierce and four Defense Jewels reach AuL and cancel the Defence penalty.
No spare slots; add recoil / reload on the weapon or swap a jewel.
For Normal HBG, use the Rathalos X gunner set.
weaponNote: Pierce HBG. Stay in critical distance; Recoil / Load are weapon-side.

name: Gravios / Indra guard
summary: Guard +1, Guard Up, and Health +30: the G-rank blocking shell.
notes: Iron Curtain and Rigid Wall Jewels plus three Strength Jewels finish the set.
No spare slots; upgrade to Guard +2 with a dedicated Guard set if you need it.
Use this shell when blocking is the comfort skill you actually want.
weaponNote: Lance and Gunlance. Evade sets are better for hop play.

name: Village 1 Battle / Hunter
summary: Village 1 starter: Attack Up (Small) from four Attack Jewels.
notes: Battle Helm / Vambraces / Greaves plus Hunter's Mail and Tasset are all available at Village 1*.
Four Attack Jewels turn the Battle pieces' Attack +6 into Attack Up (Small).
No sharpness skill yet; upgrade to full Battle or Kut-Ku as soon as the next pieces unlock.
weaponNote: Any blademaster. This is the first legal attack shell.

name: Village 1 Battle / Hunter gunner
summary: Village 1 gunner starter: Normal / Rapid Up from StrongShot Jewels.
notes: Battle Cap / Guards / Leggings plus Hunter's Vest and Coat are all available at Village 1*.
Three StrongShot Jewels push Normal S Up to activation; one Attack Jewel is a filler.
Upgrade to Kut-Ku gunner when you can reach Village 2*.
weaponNote: Normal LBG and rapid bow. Not an element set.

name: Village 1 Mafumofu
summary: Village 1 comfort: Divine Protection plus Cold Elimination.
notes: Full Mafumofu is available at Village 1* for both blademaster and gunner.
One CoolBreeze Jewel keeps the set's Heat Res penalty below activation.
Two spare slots; this is a survival shell, not a damage set.
weaponNote: Any weapon. Good for learning the first monsters and cold maps.

name: Full Rathalos
summary: Attack Up (Large) with three free slots: the simple low-rank raw bridge.
notes: Full low-rank Rathalos is available from HR1 and only needs Village 6* for the full village path.
One Paralysis Jewel cancels the set's Paralysis -10; three slots remain free.
Use this when you cannot craft the Razor Jewels for the Ceanataur mix.
weaponNote: Great Sword, Hammer, and any raw weapon that wants AuL without jewel farming.

name: Lobster evade
summary: Evade +2 with five free slots: the low-rank dodge comfort shell.
notes: Full Lobster is available from HR1 and Village 3* for both blademaster and gunner.
One Stone Wall Jewel keeps the set's Guard penalty below activation.
Five spare slots; add Health, Attack, or weapon-specific jewels.
weaponNote: SnS, DB, LS, and any weapon that wants Evade +2 before high rank.

name: Kut-Ku S starter
summary: Attack Up (Large) and Fire Resist +5 from the first high-rank Kut-Ku set.
notes: Full Kut-Ku S has Attack +15 and Defence -10. Five Defense Jewels cancel the penalty; two Fierce Jewels push Attack to AuL.
Available at HR4 and Village 7*; this is the bridge before Ceanataur / Rathalos S.
No sharpness skill; upgrade as soon as you can hunt Ceanataur.
weaponNote: Any blademaster entering high rank. Fire Resist +5 is a free bonus.

name: Kut-Ku S gunner starter
summary: Attack Up (Large) and Fire Resist +5 from the first high-rank gunner Kut-Ku set.
notes: Full Kut-Ku S gunner has the same Attack +15 / Defence -10 shell. Five Defense and two Fierce Jewels fix both.
Available at HR4 and Village 7*; use it until Silver Sol or a shot-type set is ready.
No shot-type skill; the next upgrade depends on your bowgun ammo.
weaponNote: Any gunner entering high rank. Fire Resist +5 is a free bonus.

name: Full Battle
summary: Attack Up (Small) and Sharpening Skill Inc from the first full Battle set.
notes: Full Battle unlocks at Village 2*; four Attack Jewels reach Attack Up (Small).
Sharpening Skill Inc is already active from the Battle pieces.
This is the bridge to Kut-Ku at Village 3*.
weaponNote: Any blademaster. Cheap and available before Kut-Ku.

name: Full Kut-Ku
summary: Attack Up (Medium) and Health +20: the Village 3* all-rounder.
notes: Full Kut-Ku unlocks at Village 3*; five Attack Jewels push Attack to AuM.
Health +20 and Fire Resist are free bonuses.
Use this until Rathalos / Ceanataur pieces are available.
weaponNote: Any blademaster. The standard early low-rank set.

name: Lobster gunner evade
summary: Evade +2 with five free slots: the low-rank gunner dodge shell.
notes: Full Lobster gunner is available from HR1 and Village 3*.
One Sharpshootr Jewel keeps the set's Precision -10 below activation.
Five spare slots; add Health or weapon-specific gems.
weaponNote: LBG, HBG, and bow. Evade +2 is the comfort core.

name: Full Rathalos S
summary: Attack Up (Large) + Sharpening Skill Inc: the hub-safe high-rank raw bridge.
notes: Full Rathalos S already has Attack Up (Large). Five Grinder Jewels add Sharpening Skill Inc; three slots remain free.
Available from HR5 and Village 9*. This is the hub bridge while the Artisan-jewel S+1 mix is village-gated.
Use the Ceanataur / Rathalos S mix once you can make Artisan Jewels.
weaponNote: Any raw blademaster. Great Sword and Hammer can stay here until the G-rank Crit Draw set.

name: Garuga S earplug
summary: Full Garuga S: Earplug + Crit Eye + Poison Duration Halved.
notes: Full Garuga S naturally gives Earplug and Poison Dur Halved. One Gathering Jewel cancels Gathering -10; three Expert Jewels add Crit Eye+1.
Four spare slots. Five Earplug Jewels upgrade this to HGE, but those jewels are village-gated.
Available from HR8 and Village 8*; the classic Garuga earplug shell.
weaponNote: Hammer, Hunting Horn, Great Sword, and Long Sword. Earplug covers the roars; HGE needs the village jewel path.

name: Garuga S gunner earplug
summary: Full Garuga S gunner: Earplug + Crit Eye + Poison Coat Add.
notes: Full Garuga S gunner naturally gives Earplug and Poison Coat Add. One Gathering Jewel cancels Gathering -10; three Expert Jewels add Crit Eye+1.
Four spare slots. Five Earplug Jewels upgrade to HGE, but they are village-gated.
Available from HR8 and Village 8*.
weaponNote: Status LBG and bow. Earplug protects reload and charge windows.

name: Garuga X earplug
summary: Full Garuga X: Earplug + Sharpening Skill Inc + Status Attack Up.
notes: Full Garuga X naturally gives Earplug, Sharpening Skill Inc, and Status Atk Up. One Quick Fix Jewel keeps Rec Speed -11 below activation.
Eight spare slots. Five Earplug Jewels make this HGE, but they are village-gated.
Available from HR8 and Village 10*.
weaponNote: Status weapons, Hammer, Hunting Horn, and Long Sword. Earplug is the comfort; HGE needs the village jewel path.

name: Garuga X gunner earplug
summary: Full Garuga X gunner: Earplug + Razor Coating + Status Attack Up.
notes: Full Garuga X gunner naturally gives Earplug, Razor Coating Add, and Status Atk Up. One Quick Fix Jewel cancels Rec Speed -11.
Eight spare slots. Five Earplug Jewels make this HGE, but they are village-gated.
Available from HR8 and Village 10*.
weaponNote: Status LBG and bow. Earplug protects reload and charge windows.

name: Garuga S HGE
summary: Garuga S with High Grade Earplug from five Earplug Jewels.
notes: Five Earplug Jewels turn the set's native Earplug into HGE; one Gathering Jewel keeps Gathering -10 below activation.
Village-only jewel path: Earplug Jewels need Village 4*+. The HR8 version stays at Earplug.
Two spare slots. HGE covers every roar in high rank.
weaponNote: Hammer, Hunting Horn, Great Sword, Long Sword. The village-side roar-proof Garuga.

name: Garuga S gunner HGE
summary: Garuga S gunner with High Grade Earplug from five Earplug Jewels.
notes: Five Earplug Jewels turn native Earplug into HGE; one Gathering Jewel cancels Gathering -10.
Village-only jewel path: Earplug Jewels need Village 4*+. The HR8 version stays at Earplug.
Two spare slots.
weaponNote: Status LBG and bow. HGE protects the longest reloads and charges.

name: Garuga X HGE
summary: Garuga X with High Grade Earplug, Razor Sharp, and Status Attack Up.
notes: Five Earplug Jewels turn native Earplug into HGE; one Quick Fix Jewel keeps Rec Speed -11 below activation.
Village-only jewel path: Earplug Jewels need Village 4*+. The HR8 version stays at Earplug.
Three spare slots.
weaponNote: Status weapons, Hammer, HH, and LS. The village-side HGE Garuga.

name: Garuga X gunner HGE
summary: Garuga X gunner with HGE, Razor Coating, and Status Attack Up.
notes: Five Earplug Jewels turn native Earplug into HGE; one Quick Fix Jewel cancels Rec Speed -11.
Village-only jewel path: Earplug Jewels need Village 4*+. The HR8 version stays at Earplug.
Three spare slots.
weaponNote: Status LBG and bow. The village-side HGE Garuga.

name: G High Wind Res
summary: High Wind Res 19: cancels large wind pressure from Rathalos, Diablos, Tigrex, Lao, and Fatalis.
notes: Six spare slots. Add damage or another counter skill.
High Wind Res does not stop Dragon Wind from Kushala, Chameleos, Lunastra, or Teostra.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: G Dragon Wind Breaker
summary: Dragon Wind Breaker 24: cancels Kushala, Chameleos, Lunastra, and Teostra wind auras.
notes: One Solid Rock Jewel finishes Dragon Wind Breaker; three spare slots.
Use this for elder dragon wind, not ordinary high wind.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: G Quake Res
summary: Quake Res 16: stops tremors from Diablos, Tigrex, Akantor, Ukanlos, Rajang, Lavasioth, and Shen Gaoren.
notes: Six spare slots. Add damage or a status counter.
Quake Res does not stop roars or wind pressure.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: G HGE + Quake
summary: High Grade Earplug + Quake Res: the Diablos, Tigrex, Rajang, and Akantor shell.
notes: Covers large roars and tremors. Three spare slots.
Cannot also fit High Wind Res; use the HGE + Wind card for wind-heavy fights.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: G HGE + High Wind
summary: High Grade Earplug + High Wind Res: roars and large wind pressure together.
notes: One spare slot. Use for Rathalos, Rathian, Lao, Fatalis, and wind-heavy Diablos/Tigrex.
Cannot also fit Quake Res; use the HGE + Quake card for tremor-heavy fights.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: G HGE + Dragon Wind
summary: High Grade Earplug + Dragon Wind Breaker: the elder dragon aura shell.
notes: Covers roars and Dragon Wind for Kushala, Chameleos, Lunastra, and Teostra.
No spare slots; this is a dedicated aura counter.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: G HGE + Poison
summary: High Grade Earplug + Poison Negated: the Rathian/Rathalos counter.
notes: Covers roars and poison. No spare slots.
For Gold Rathian and Silver Rathalos this also covers their HGE roar.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: G Poison Negated
summary: Poison Negated 16: the Gypceros and Iodrome counter.
notes: Four spare slots. Add damage or another status counter.
Carving Iron Man is incidental; ignore it if you do not need it.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: G Sleep Negated
summary: Sleep Negated 16: the Hypnocatrice counter.
notes: Ten spare slots. Add damage or another counter skill.
Sleep Negated is enough; you do not need full status immunity.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: G Paralysis Negated
summary: Paralysis Negated 16: the Gendrome and Vespoid Queen counter.
notes: Eight spare slots. Add damage or another counter skill.
Useful for any fight where paralysis chains into a cart.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: G Faint Negated
summary: Faint Negated 15: stops stun from repeated hits.
notes: Ten spare slots. Add damage or another counter skill.
Use it on Gypceros, Khezu, Tigrex, Nargacuga, Rajang, and Garuga if stun is the problem.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: High High Wind Res
summary: High Wind Res 18: cancels large wind pressure at high rank.
notes: Supreme Mizuha pieces supply WindPress without jewels. Six spare slots.
Does not stop Dragon Wind from elder dragons.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: High Dragon Wind Breaker
summary: Dragon Wind Breaker 21: cancels elder dragon wind auras at high rank.
notes: One HeavyMetal Jewel finishes Dragon Wind Breaker. Four spare slots.
Use for Kushala, Chameleos, Lunastra, and Teostra.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: High Quake Res
summary: Quake Res + Guard +1: the high-rank tremor shell.
notes: One Tectonic Jewel finishes Quake Res. Five spare slots.
Guard +1 is incidental; it helps lance/gunlance but is not required.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: High HGE + Quake
summary: High Grade Earplug + Quake Res at high rank.
notes: Three Tectonic and one Anchor Jewel finish Quake Res.
Village-side Earplug Jewels; hub players need village 4★+ for the jewels.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: High HGE + High Wind
summary: High Grade Earplug + High Wind Res at high rank.
notes: Four Earplug Jewels finish HGE; three spare slots.
Village-side Earplug Jewels; this is the high-rank Rathalos/Rathian/Lao counter.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: High HGE + Dragon Wind
summary: High Grade Earplug + Dragon Wind Breaker at high rank.
notes: Four Earplug, one HeavyMetal, and one Paperweight Jewel. No spare slots.
Dedicated elder dragon aura counter.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: High HGE + Poison
summary: High Grade Earplug + Poison Negated at high rank.
notes: Six Anti-Toxin Jewels finish Poison Negated; no spare slots.
Covers Rathian/Rathalos roars and poison in one high-rank shell.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: High Poison Negated
summary: Poison Negated 15: the high-rank Gypceros/Iodrome counter.
notes: No jewels needed; eight spare slots.
Add damage or another status counter.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: High Sleep Negated
summary: Sleep Negated 20: the high-rank Hypnocatrice counter.
notes: No jewels needed; seven spare slots.
Sleep Negated is enough; you do not need full status immunity.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: High Paralysis Negated
summary: Paralysis Negated 16: the high-rank Gendrome/Vespoid Queen counter.
notes: Three Petrification Jewels; eight spare slots.
Useful when paralysis chains into a cart.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: High Faint Negated
summary: Faint Negated 20: stops stun from repeated hits at high rank.
notes: One Vigilance Jewel; six spare slots.
Use it on Gypceros, Khezu, Tigrex, Nargacuga, Rajang, and Garuga if stun is the problem.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: HR HGE + High Wind
summary: HR-legal HGE + High Wind Res using a Silencer Jewel instead of village-gated Earplug Jewels.
notes: Silencer + HeavyMetal Jewels finish both skills; three spare slots.
Available from HR6. This is the hub-side Rathalos/Rathian/Diablos/Tigrex wind counter.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: G HR HGE + Quake
summary: G-rank HR-legal HGE + Quake Res using a Silencer Jewel.
notes: Silencer + Tectonic Jewels; three spare slots.
Hub HR8+. Covers Diablos, Tigrex, Rajang, and Akantor roars + tremors.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: G HR HGE + High Wind
summary: G-rank HR-legal HGE + High Wind Res using a Silencer Jewel.
notes: Silencer + two HeavyMetal Jewels; one spare slot.
Hub HR8+. Covers Rathalos, Rathian, Lao, Fatalis, and wind-heavy Diablos/Tigrex.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: G HR HGE + Poison
summary: G-rank HR-legal HGE + Poison Negated.
notes: Eight Anti-Toxin Jewels; no spare slots.
Hub HR9. Covers Gold Rathian and Silver Rathalos roars + poison.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.

name: G HR HGE
summary: G-rank HR-legal High Grade Earplug with twelve free slots.
notes: No jewels needed. Native HGE from the Rathalos Soul / Diablo Z shell.
Hub HR9. Use it as a base and add damage or another counter skill.
weaponNote: Counter set for the listed large-monster effects.
